answer_1.quote: We propose 3MDBench, an open-source benchmark for evaluating medical dialogue systems... with an Assessor Agent measuring diagnostic accuracy and communication quality, and a Patient Agent simulating temperament-based personality-driven doctor‑patient conversations.
answer_1.outputs: Multi‑turn doctor‑patient dialogues including diagnostic conclusions, treatment recommendations, and communication quality assessments.

answer_2.quote: Dialogue raises GPT-4o-mini's F1 from 50.4 (image + basic complaint BCk) to 54.2% (p < 0.01)...

answer_3.quote: Assessor Agent is responsible for evaluating doctor agents in generated dialogues and extracting final diagnoses from the doctor's conclusions... candidate assessor models are Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct, GPT-4o-mini, Llava-OneVision-Qwen2-72b-ov-chat-hf, and DeepSeek-VL.

answer_4.quote: Five human annotators rated dialogues and extracted diagnoses using the exact instructions as the Assessor Agent (Appendix H.4).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluated dialogues and extracted diagnoses following the Assessor Agent prompts, based on the Mini‑CEX criteria.
